mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pisces_experiment_config (experiment_id, config_version, metadata_json) VALUES (#{entity.experimentId}, #{entity.configVersion}, #{entity.metadataJson}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_version = VALUES(config_version), metadata_json = VALUES(metadata_json), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT experiment_id FROM pisces_experiment_config ORDER BY experiment_id
